name: PCA
description: Principal component analysis of one or more numeric columns. The covariance (or correlation when standardize is true) matrix comes from DuckDB sums and cross products and is decomposed in Java by a Jacobi eigen decomposition, so only p-by-p matrices are held in memory and the row count is unbounded. scores mode appends pc1..pcN to the input via an SQL projection, loadings mode returns one row per component and column, and explained mode returns the eigenvalue, the explained-variance fraction and the cumulative fraction per component. Features are optionally z-score standardized; the sign of every component is fixed so its largest absolute loading is positive.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Numeric columns the components are computed on; at least one.

components.title: Components
components.description: Number of principal components to return; must not exceed the number of selected columns.

standardize.title: Standardize
standardize.description: Z-score every feature before the decomposition; a constant column becomes zero.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: scores appends pc1..pcN to the input rows, loadings returns one row per component and column, explained returns the eigenvalue and variance fractions per component.

sample_rows.title: Sample rows
sample_rows.description: 0 uses every complete row (no cap); a positive N computes the covariance matrix on a deterministic reservoir sample of N rows (DuckDB USING SAMPLE reservoir(N ROWS) REPEATABLE(seed)).

seed.title: Sampling seed
seed.description: Seed for the repeatable reservoir sample; the same input and seed give the same fit. Ignored when sample_rows is 0. Must be 0 or positive.
